title: fix(ui): preserve exact display-precision Pollen amounts
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: Fixed wallet formatting so Pollen amounts already within the four-decimal display limit keep their exact displayed value instead of being floored after floating-point scaling. Added a regression test for that case and bumped the UI package to 0.1.0-alpha.10.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; small-to-medium in the scene, she wears tiny accountant glasses and points to a wallet screen whose four-decimal Pollen balance stays put beside a sprouting code-plant. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
